mapper.insert: INSERT INTO events ( id, tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id, event_type, destination, payload, tags, status, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id, typeHandler=com.hookflow.hookflow.common.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{tenantId, typeHandler=com.hookflow.hookflow.common.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestId}, #{eventType}, #{destination}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.hookflow.hookflow.common.mybatis.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.hookflow.hookflow.common.mybatis.JsonbListTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id, event_type, destination, payload, tags, status, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at FROM events WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.hookflow.hookflow.common.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT id, tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id, event_type, destination, payload, tags, status, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at FROM events WHERE status = 'PUBLISH_FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
